q: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
exp: Mitochondria produces ATP through cellular respiration.
ai_exp:
Cell Organelle Analysis:

• Nucleus: Control center, contains DNA ✗
• Ribosome: Protein synthesis ✗
• Mitochondria: ATP production (energy) ✓
• Golgi apparatus: Protein packaging ✗

Mitochondria = Powerhouse
• Site of cellular respiration
• Produces ATP (energy currency)

Option A: Controls cell activities ✗
Option B: Makes proteins ✗
Option C: Produces energy ✓ Correct!
Option D: Packages proteins ✗

The correct answer is C) Mitochondria.

q: The process by which green plants manufacture their food is:
exp: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight.
ai_exp:
Plant Process Analysis:

• Respiration: Breaking down food for energy ✗
• Photosynthesis: Making food using sunlight ✓
• Transpiration: Water loss from leaves ✗
• Digestion: Breaking down food (animals) ✗

Photosynthesis equation:
6CO₂ + 6H₂O + sunlight → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂

Option A: Energy release ✗
Option B: Food production ✓ Correct!
Option C: Water loss ✗
Option D: Food breakdown ✗

The correct answer is B) Photosynthesis.

q: Which blood group is called the universal donor?
exp: Group O negative blood can be given to any blood type.
ai_exp:
Blood Group Analysis:

• Group A: Can donate to A and AB ✗
• Group B: Can donate to B and AB ✗
• Group AB: Universal RECIPIENT ✗
• Group O: Universal DONOR ✓

Group O negative:
• No A or B antigens on red cells
• Can be given to any blood type

Option A: Limited donation ✗
Option B: Limited donation ✗
Option C: Universal recipient ✗
Option D: Universal donor ✓ Correct!

The correct answer is D) Group O.

q: The basic unit of inheritance in living organisms is:
exp: Genes are the basic units of heredity and inheritance.
ai_exp:
Genetic Terminology:

• Cell: Basic unit of life ✗
• Nucleus: Contains genetic material ✗
• Gene: Unit of inheritance ✓
• Chromosome: Structure containing genes ✗

Hierarchy:
Cell → Nucleus → Chromosome → GENE (unit of inheritance)

Option A: Structural unit ✗
Option B: Contains DNA ✗
Option C: Unit of inheritance ✓ Correct!
Option D: Carries genes ✗

The correct answer is C) Gene.

exp: Insulin is produced by the pancreas, not the liver.
ai_exp:

Pancreas Functions:

Option B: Liver function ✗
Option C: PANCREAS function ✓ Correct!

q: The process by which water moves from root hairs to the xylem is called:
exp: Osmosis is the movement of water from high to low concentration through a semi-permeable membrane.
ai_exp:
Water Movement Analysis:

• Diffusion: Movement of molecules from high to low concentration ✗
• Osmosis: Movement of WATER through semi-permeable membrane ✓
• Transpiration: Water LOSS from leaves ✗
• Active transport: Against concentration gradient (needs energy) ✗

Water from soil → root hairs → xylem = OSMOSIS

Option A: General molecule movement ✗
Option B: Water-specific movement ✓ Correct!
Option C: Evaporation from leaves ✗
Option D: Energy-requiring process ✗

The correct answer is B) Osmosis.

q: Which vitamin is produced by the skin when exposed to sunlight?
exp: Vitamin D is synthesized in the skin upon exposure to UV light from sunlight.
ai_exp:
Vitamin Production Analysis:

• Vitamin A: Found in carrots, liver ✗
• Vitamin C: Found in citrus fruits ✗
• Vitamin D: SYNTHESIZED by skin in sunlight ✓
• Vitamin K: Produced by gut bacteria ✗

Vitamin D:
• Produced in skin
• Requires UV exposure
• Important for calcium absorption

Option A: Dietary ✗
Option B: Dietary ✗
Option C: Sunlight synthesis ✓ Correct!
Option D: Bacterial synthesis ✗

The correct answer is C) Vitamin D.

q: The number of chromosomes in a normal human body cell is:
exp: Humans have 46 chromosomes (23 pairs) in body cells.
ai_exp:
Chromosome Analysis:

• 23 = Number of pairs (or chromosomes in gametes) ✗
• 44 = Autosomes (non-sex chromosomes) ✗
• 46 = Total chromosomes in somatic cells ✓
• 48 = Incorrect ✗

Human cells:
• 46 chromosomes total
• 23 pairs (22 autosomes + 1 sex pair)
• Gametes (sperm/egg) have 23 chromosomes

Option A: Gamete number ✗
Option B: Autosome count ✗
Option C: Body cell number ✓ Correct!
Option D: Incorrect ✗

The correct answer is C) 46.

q: Which part of the brain controls balance and coordination?
exp: The cerebellum controls balance, posture, and coordination.
ai_exp:
Brain Structure Analysis:

• Cerebrum: Thinking, memory, voluntary movement ✗
• Cerebellum: BALANCE and COORDINATION ✓
• Medulla oblongata: Heart rate, breathing ✗
• Hypothalamus: Temperature, hunger, thirst ✗

Cerebellum:
• Located at back of brain
• Controls fine motor skills
• Maintains posture

Option A: Higher functions ✗
Option B: Balance/coordination ✓ Correct!
Option C: Autonomic functions ✗
Option D: Homeostasis ✗

The correct answer is B) Cerebellum.

q: The process of cell division that produces gametes is:
exp: Meiosis produces gametes (sperm and eggs) with half the chromosome number.
ai_exp:
Cell Division Analysis:

• Mitosis: Produces identical diploid cells for growth ✗
• Meiosis: Produces haploid gametes ✓
• Binary fission: Asexual reproduction in bacteria ✗
• Budding: Asexual reproduction in yeast ✗

Meiosis:
• Reduces chromosome number by half
• Produces 4 haploid cells
• Creates genetic variation

Option A: Growth/repair ✗
Option B: Gamete production ✓ Correct!
Option C: Bacterial reproduction ✗
Option D: Asexual reproduction ✗

The correct answer is B) Meiosis.
